_note: THIS IS NOT A PASS. It is a documented gap, recorded so nobody assumes otherwise. A correctly signed, unexpired token whose aud was 'https://totally-unrelated-api.example.com/' was ACCEPTED and proxied to the upstream. Reproduced twice against a deployed route.
_cause: claim_validator.audience exposes only: required (is the claim present), claim (which claim name to read), match_with_client_id (must the value equal/contain the client id). There is NO expected-value field. IdP access tokens carry aud = the API's audience URI, not the client id, so match_with_client_id does not apply to them either.
_what_to_do: Pin claim_validator.issuer.valid_issuers, which IS enforced, and use required_scopes to distinguish APIs within one tenant. Do not rely on aud to scope a token to a single API on this plugin.
_body_example: the upstream's normal payload — the request was proxied as if fully authorized
